meaning: Complete finite semantic review of the planning deliverable, including all scientific inputs and criticism; not universal correctness or executed application validation.

axes.name: Material original obligations and negative constraints
axes.reason: All material queue size, four-worker, progress, stop, owned-output and separate-layer requirements are represented. Admission rejection and force abandonment remain distinct. No deployment or hard-stop guarantee is invented.

axes.name: Consequential source facts, governing conditions, versions and applicability
axes.reason: The fixed release pin/tag resolves correctly; public queue bodies equal the caches. Immediate shutdown removes waiting entries from unfinished accounting while retrieved work still requires acknowledgment. Cancellation and loop limits are correct. N1 records inaccurate line anchors, not false mechanism facts.

axes.name: Useful unfamiliar mechanisms, alternatives and implementation/failure history
axes.reason: Retains blocked-producer rejection, queue/accounting versus outcomes, compatibility sentinels and worker-count alternatives. CPU work is moved to an independently assessed execution layer; the concrete process option survives in C15 and linked docs but is less explicit in final prose (N2).

axes.name: Valid corrections, rejections and exact plan dispositions
axes.reason: All 9 critique findings and C01-C19 dispositions checked against the whole draft. Rejection of force-stop success/Completed/double-count reasoning is valid. Six seconds and ideal two jobs/second remain conditional. No legitimate queue capability is falsely rejected.

axes.name: Supported meaning retained from draft and criticism into the complete final
axes.reason: The complete final carries the bounded queue, outcome ledger, acknowledgment discipline, graceful drain, cleanup/retained outputs, sentinel compatibility and model assumptions forward. C15-to-final process specificity is a nonmaterial limitation, explicitly recorded.

axes.name: Meaningful proposed validation, with executed work distinguished
axes.reason: Seven discriminating planned test groups retain blocked admissions, exceptions/cancellation, zero/slow jobs, duplicate acknowledgment and cleanup and add per-ID force reconciliation. No local witness/benchmark is claimed. Upstream tests were inspected, not executed.

obligations.obligation: CPython 3.13.9; Queue(maxsize=20); four one-job workers; descriptor ownership; conditional 24 outstanding bound and excluded producer/history memory
Successful-put acceptance, per-ID in-session ledger, queued versus running versus terminal progress and thread confinement
Graceful admission closure, non-immediate shutdown, drain/acknowledge accepted work, await workers and retain results
Force-stop abandonment versus active cancellation; no success from qsize/join; no extra acknowledgment of drained jobs
Failure/cancellation never counted as conversion success; exactly one task_done per retrieved item; cancellation before get has none; cooperative stop and external-layer boundary
Component-owned temporary/output paths, validation and publish success gate, cleanup failures, completed-output retention and unspecified destination policy
Retain 12 equal ready jobs, four workers, two seconds: six-second makespan; ideal saturated two jobs/second; no arbitrary-workload or measured-throughput inference
Native shutdown versus conditional older-runtime sentinels; sequential/more workers and CPU execution alternatives
Full draft, all generated criticism and dispositions, preserved supported meaning, legitimate rejections and unresolved questions
Discriminating planned queue/application tests; separate actual execution, upstream test inspection, target version and model measurements

consequential_source_families.family: Queue API, full implementation/dependencies/caller and regression tests
Target release identity and scoped introduction/fix/documentation context
Output staging, success gate and cleanup proposal / claimed API scope
consequential_source_families.qualification: Control leaves publish primitive/policy unselected; treatment proposes conditional replace and secure named-temp mechanisms. Neither claims measured platform or crash guarantees.

consequential_source_families.family: Conditional capacity and ideal scheduling derivation
consequential_source_families.independent_check: Twelve two-second jobs require 24 worker-seconds, so four workers require at least six seconds; three simultaneous equal waves attain it. Under homogeneous saturation, four completions per two seconds gives two jobs/second.

consequential_source_families.qualification: Control reports no executed witness; treatment observed frozen execution record and independently replayed bounded code. No application execution is inferred.

outside_declared_assessment.reason: Not part of this frozen component assessment.
